app/src/routes/index.tsx:1 — only useSignal/useVisibleTask$, stable since v1.x

reach.rationale: The app uses only long-stable Qwik 1.x and Vite APIs; it deliberately avoids the Qwik 2.0 RC line that exists as of today.

evidence: app/src/lib/api.ts:1-11 — all data access isolated in one module with a plain fetch cache
app/adapters/node-server/vite.config.ts:1-3 — server wiring confined to a stock adapter config
containment.rationale: Nothing experimental to contain; the handful of framework integration points (entries, adapter, vite config) are stock starter files, so any future v2 migration is centralized.

evidence: app/src/routes/layout.tsx:1-29 — plain Slot/component$ layout, no exotic APIs
justification.rationale: No experimental or preview APIs are used at all; every need was met with the stable API surface.

findings.issue: Static analysis flagged Vite's `preview` config block as experimental; it is a stable Vite option since Vite 2 (2021) and the file even links the official docs at line 57.
findings.suggestion: No change needed; ignore this marker in tooling.

findings.issue: `typescript-plugin-css-modules` is pinned to `latest` and `undici` to `*` — floating version pins that can silently pull in newer, untested releases (and the css-modules plugin appears unused since styles are plain CSS classes).
findings.suggestion: Pin concrete versions, and drop typescript-plugin-css-modules and its tsconfig plugin entry (app/tsconfig.json:23) if unused.

findings.issue: Qwik 2.0 is in RC as of Oct 2026 and renames packages (@builder.io/* → @qwik.dev/*); the app is correctly on stable 1.x, but the eventual v2 migration will touch package names, config, and entry files.
findings.suggestion: When upgrading, run the official `qwik migrate-v2` codemod on a dedicated branch; current stable-only usage minimizes the diff.

summary: This app is entirely on Qwik/Qwik City's current stable release (1.20.3) and uses only APIs that have been stable since the 1.x era. It avoids the Qwik 2.0 beta/RC line entirely, and the single measured 'experimental' marker is a false positive on Vite's stable preview config. Experimental risk is effectively zero; the only forward-looking caution is the routine v2 package-rename migration that will eventually come.
